page_title: NAP 0-1 LAZ | Napoli v Lazio 08/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Here is a change. Nuno Tavares is going off and Marco Baroni gives the last tactical orders to Samuel Gigot (Lazio).
90+2' That's the end of the game for Gustav Isaksen, who is replaced by Manuel Lazzari (Lazio).
90+2' A substitution has been made. Romelu Lukaku goes off and Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) comes on.
90+1' The referee allows time for a substitution. Frank Anguissa will be replaced by Michael Folorunsho (Napoli).
90+1' We will have 5 min. of added time.
86' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Napoli.
82' Antonio Conte prepares a substitution. Scott McTominay is replaced by Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli).
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Billy Gilmour (Napoli) will replace Stanislav Lobotka.

79' 0 - 1 Goal! Tijjani Noslin finds Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) with a clever pass. He steps inside his man on the edge of the box and whips a tremendous shot into the left side of the goal. Fantasy football! 0:1.
76' Antonio Conte has decided to substitute Matteo Politano and he is replaced by David Neres (Napoli).
72' Boulaye Dia goes off the pitch and Pedro (Lazio) comes on.
72' We are about to witness a subsitution. Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) for Taty Castellanos.
72' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) sees his header crash off the right post after meeting a corner kick inside the six-yard box. The goalkeeper would have been helpless.
71' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
70' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance towards the bottom right corner, but Alex Meret is alert and makes a decent save.
66' The foul by Frank Anguissa (Napoli) was seen by Andrea Colombo who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
62' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
61' Alessio Romagnoli is substituted due to injury. Marco Baroni gives a chance to Patric (Lazio).
61' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ivan Provedel intercepts the ball.
53' It should have been a goal! Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) fires a rocket of a shot but it only hits the crossbar!
51' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
51' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) launches a cross from the corner, but Ivan Provedel is alert to thwart the effort.

50' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Corner kick. Napoli will have an opportunity.
50' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

49' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Napoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
46' Scott McTominay (Napoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Andrea Colombo had an easy-decision to make.
46' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+3' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) sends the resulting free kick a whisker wide of the left post!
45+2' Yellow card. Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
45+1' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
44' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) was too forceful with his tackle and Andrea Colombo interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
43' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.

42' Scott McTominay (Napoli) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Napoli will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
40' The ball is cleared after Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
37' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Matteo Politano (Napoli), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
33' Chance! Frank Anguissa (Napoli) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the bottom right corner, but Ivan Provedel is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
31' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
31' Napoli are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
21' The corner is swung in but Lazio can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
21' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Alex Meret stops the ball from going inside the left post.
19' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Boulaye Dia (Lazio) was quite harsh and Andrea Colombo didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
18' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
16' Lazio can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
15' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Lazio will take a corner kick.
13' Scott McTominay (Napoli) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Andrea Colombo saw the whole situation.
11' Scott McTominay (Napoli) meets a cross inside the box, but Ivan Provedel wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
10' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
6' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
4' The resulting set piece from Napoli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

3' Great save! Scott McTominay (Napoli) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the right side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Ivan Provedel. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Lazio will kick-off.
Andrea Colombo was nominated as the referee for this game.
